episodes.synopsis: A young high-school girl, Ruko, receives a deck of cards, the WIXOSS. In the deck, she finds an unusual talking card. Bewildered, she meets Yuzuki, who she calls herself a "Selector." Soon, Ruko finds herself in battle to be the "Eternal Girl."
episodes.title: This Miracle Trembles

episodes.synopsis: Ruko, along with her new friend, Yuzuki, come across a battle of Selectors, Akira versus Hitoe. Yuzuki must now prepare to fight the winner, Akira.
episodes.title: Their Meeting Was Toxic

episodes.synopsis: Ruko finds herself in battle against Hitoe, and taps into a desire she has never felt before. Meanwhile, Yuzuki's battle ensues against Akira.
episodes.title: This Peace Is Nonsensical

episodes.synopsis: Ruko and Yuzuki become friends with Hitoe, with hope for a lasting friendship. Akira, wanting to battle Ruko, faces her, but then Iona appears...
episodes.title: That Wish Is Blasphemy

episodes.synopsis: While waiting for Ruko and Yuzuki, Hitoe is defeated in battle. The repercussions from Hitoe's third loss is beyond Ruko and Yuzuki's imagination...
episodes.title: That Vow Is Illicit

episodes.synopsis: Ruko battles Akira with a resolve unlike before. Meanwhile, Yuzuki comes to a resolve on her own after a meeting with a new Selector.
episodes.title: This Heart Is Pure White

episodes.synopsis: As Ruko seeks answers, she comes in contact with Iona who soon senses affinity towards Ruko. Later, Ruko and Yuzuki is contacted by Akira...
episodes.title: That Girl Is Desire

episodes.synopsis: After Yuzuki parts ways with Ruko, Yuzuki wins to become an Eternal Girl, but... Later, Hitoe gets a new deck of WIXOSS and finds a new LRIG...
episodes.title: That Oath Is Falsehood

episodes.synopsis: Word spreads of the intimate, yet forbidden love Yuzuki has towards Kazuki. Meanwhile, Ruko learns the horror of what happened to the 'true' Yuzuki.
episodes.title: That Truth Is Cruel

episodes.synopsis: The mysteries around WIXOSS begin to reveal, with an unusual girl at center, Mayu. Meanwhile, a message is sent from Iona to the Selectors...
episodes.title: That Emotion Is Stranded

episodes.synopsis: New secrets unravel with the mysterious girl, Mayu. Iona gathers the Selectors to have battles, with an ulterior motive in Iona's mind...
episodes.title: That Summer Is Longing

episodes.synopsis: Ruko's battle finally comes to a close. Everyone has made a choice to their ways, and the results are...
episodes.title: That Selection Is...
